title: [Webinar] Making Feedback Work in Agile Teams
summary: Sumeet Moghe, Training Manager, Thoughtworks, shares the key to success in Agile teams. Feedback in peer groups facilitates a shift from ‘forming, storming and norming’ to the most effective stage in the Tuckman's model - performing.
